preconditions.description: The consummatory-aware LocalViewGreedyPolicy (reads the SAME 5x5 resource_field_view and CONSUMEs on contact) forages above the 1.0 floor in the CONSUMMATORY env -- the positive control that the env is solvable from the local view WITH a consummatory act. Below-floor means the substrate/env is not ready, NOT that a drive failed.

preconditions.name: consumbind_extinct_off::greedy_oracle_clears_floor_at_d3
preconditions.description: Consummatory env is floor-achievable with global info (achievability anchor).
preconditions.control: consummatory greedy_oracle foraging_competence @D3 vs the 1.0 floor (live, ~42)

preconditions.name: consumbind_extinct_off::post_bc_install_took
preconditions.description: THE LOAD-BEARING READINESS PRECONDITION. The CALIBRATED BC install must have taken to a USABLE level before RL: post_bc_foraging_competence (measured pre-RL, post warm-start, in the consummatory env) clears USABLE_INSTALL_FLOOR (10.0) on the WORST seed of this arm. 821's bug was accepting a 4.3 install (cleared 1.0 but useless), producing a degenerate two-arms-at-zero comparison. An install below the usable floor is UNINFORMATIVE about retention -- there is no usable installed prior to retain -- so the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than any retention verdict.
preconditions.control: post-BC / pre-RL foraging_competence of this arm's worst seed vs the 10.0 usable floor

criteria.name: C_extinguishing_drive_retains_installed_competence
criteria.description: The extinguishing (consummatory) arm holds a strict majority of seeds at retained_fraction >= 0.5 AND beats the non-extinguishing control's mean retained_fraction by >= 0.15.

criteria.name: C_non_extinguishing_control_erodes_installed_competence
criteria.description: The non-extinguishing control does NOT hold the installed competence -- the contrast the treatment is read against.

anchor_reachability.reference_source: live consummatory anchors this run: local_view_greedy=34.167, greedy_oracle=42.800 (the consummatory install band the BC demonstrator clones toward; usable floor 10.0)

interpretation_grid.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchor is sub-floor, OR post_bc_foraging_competence fails the 10.0 USABLE install floor on a strict majority of seeds in either arm
interpretation_grid.reading: There is no usable installed prior to retain, so the run is UNINFORMATIVE about retention (this is exactly the 821 degenerate-install failure this re-run fixes). NEVER a retention verdict and never substrate_ceiling / does_not_support. Requeue (dose / install-mechanism work).

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_retains_competence
interpretation_grid.condition: the extinguishing arm retains on a strict majority of seeds AND beats the non-extinguishing control's mean retained_fraction by the declared margin
interpretation_grid.reading: 781's drive-side null WAS a consummatory-act artefact: an approach drive that extinguishes on contact and hands off to CONSUME does not suppress foraging.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_succeeded_then_decayed
interpretation_grid.condition: the extinguishing arm's trajectory PEAK cleared the install floor on a strict majority of seeds, but its terminal retained_fraction fell below the retention floor
interpretation_grid.reading: The manipulation SUCCEEDED and then DECAYED -- a retention-DYNAMICS finding, not a null. Read the trajectory and the half-life, not the terminal scalar.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_eroded_under_both
interpretation_grid.condition: neither arm retains and their mean retained_fraction differ by less than the declared margin
interpretation_grid.reading: THE DECLARED NULL. The installed prior erodes identically whether or not the drive extinguishes -> the extinguish-and-hand-off binding is NOT the retention mechanism (H-consummation-binding eliminated). Does NOT weaken MECH-457 (diagnostic). Unlike 821, this reading is now made against a USABLE install (post_bc >= 10) so a null is a real erosion, not an install artefact.

interpretation_grid.label: consummation_binding_grid_nondiscriminative
interpretation_grid.condition: no arm passed its precondition gate, or the arms/anchors do not separate
interpretation_grid.reading: Not a refutation. Unscored; re-pose the measurement.
